articles.title: Chinese Threat Actor Uses Leaked DarkSword Kit to Deploy GHOSTBLADE on iOS
articles.summary: An unknown Chinese-threat actor has been observed running a campaign targeting Apple iOS devices by leveraging a publicly leaked version of the DarkSword  exploit kit.   Attack surface management platform Censys said it identified the threat actor running more than 100 web properties, most of which are fake Amazon Web Services (AWS) sign-in pages on a domain that also hosts the exploit toolkit.   "The hosting concentrates in Hong Kong but reaches into Japan, the United States, and Europe," Censys researcher Aidan Holland said  in an analysis published on July 31, 2026.   DarkSword, discovered and detailed earlier this year by Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG), iVerify, and Lookout, refers to a full-chain exploit kit  that is believed to have been used by commercial surveillance vendors and suspected state-sponsored actors in disparate campaigns targeting Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Malaysia, and Ukraine since at least November 2025. articles.title_fr: Un acteur de menace chinois utilise le kit DarkSword divulgué pour déployer GHOSTBLADE sur iOS
articles.summary_fr: Un acteur de menace chinois non identifié a été observé menant une campagne ciblant les appareils Apple iOS en exploitant une version divulguée publiquement du kit d'exploit DarkSword. La plateforme Censys a identifié plus de 100 propriétés web, principalement de fausses pages de connexion AWS, hébergeant ce kit d'exploit. DarkSword est un kit d'exploit complet, utilisé depuis novembre 2025 par des fournisseurs de surveillance commerciaux et des acteurs étatiques présumés, ciblant divers pays.

articles.title: PNLD Breach Exposes U.K. Police and Government Contact Details on Dark Web
articles.summary: The Police National Legal Database (PNLD) has confirmed that police, government and customer contact information was compromised and published on the dark web.   The data included names, organisations and work email addresses belonging to police officers, police staff, criminal justice professionals, government partners and customers.   The incident, identified on July 26, also exposed some names and email addresses belonging to people who had submitted questions through Ask the Police. That exposure could make phishing messages targeting named officers appear more convincing, according to UK government guidance .   PNLD said, "There is no evidence to suggest that passwords or other security credentials have been compromised." The service provides legal information, products and services to UK police forces and criminal justice organisations. articles.title: Thermo Fisher Patches Flaw That Could Make DNA File Tampering Nearly Undetectable
articles.summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific has patched a flaw in select Applied Biosystems human identification software that could allow data files to be altered before analysis software loads them.   The vendor's July 31 security bulletin says nearly undetectable changes to .fsa and .hid outputs could occur if laboratory controls are circumvented.   Thermo Fisher tracks the issue as CVE-2026-17583 and rates it High with a CVSS v4.0 score of 8.2. Five supported product lines have received updates that add digital signatures, while three end-of-life data collection products will receive no vendor update.   Thermo Fisher credits Nathan Adams, Kevin Dyer and Laura Gaydosh Combs, together with the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency, with identifying the issue and coordinating disclosure. Bonjour et bienvenue dans votre Flash Info Cyber du jour ! L'actualité cyber nous emmène d'abord vers la Chine, où un acteur de menace non identifié cible activement les appareils Apple iOS. Ce groupe utilise une version divulguée du kit d'exploit DarkSword, hébergé sur plus d'une centaine de fausses pages de connexion AWS pour distribuer le logiciel malveillant GHOSTBLADE.
